subject: OrthoHealth — data transfer evidence, DPA redline & subprocessor map
body:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-29 09:12 -0700
Subject: OrthoHealth — kickoff: evidence pack + timeline

Team,

OrthoHealth's CISO has asked for a consolidated evidence pack to close their procurement review this quarter. Key asks they listed in the call:
- Signed DPA with our standard SCCs (EU) + confirmation on UK IDTA approach and whether we accept the UK Addendum
- Full subprocessor inventory (including cloud infra and any managed services), with subprocessors' country of processing and whether they persist customer content
- Any TIA/DTIA planning or compensating controls for edge cases

Can Legal and Security split the work? Proposed owner breakdown:
- Laura: DPA redline review and short position memo on the UK addendum (accept/conditional/decline)
- Vivek: TIA/DTIA notes and any required mitigations; confirm if we need extra attestations from infra providers
- Priyom: produce subprocessor_inventory_20261029.csv and a short note on which subs we can avoid or push to EU-only processing in the short term

Deadline: OrthoHealth wants evidence by EOD Nov 2 PT. I'll coordinate the final deliverable and share the Drive folder (see link when ready).

Attachments: request template (I put a stub in the Drive)

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Emily Chau <emily.chau@orthohealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Smith <michael.smith@lawfirmllp.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrthoHealth — DPA redline and evidence needs

Hi Sofia,

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Attaching our DPA redline (Ortho_DPA_Redline_v2.pdf) — primary concerns: cross-border routing, subprocessor visibility, audit rights, and a UK-specific carve-out for transfers to third countries. Our legal counsel (copied) would prefer Redwood to:
1) Confirm you accept the UK Addendum (or provide equivalent contractual safeguards)
2) Supply a current subprocessor list with locations and whether they have access to decrypted customer data
3) Confirm whether any backups or disaster recovery systems replicate data outside the EU/UK and where

Can we get the subprocessor list and a note on backups by Nov 2 so our security team can sign off?

Best,
Emily Chau
Head of IT Risk, OrthoHealth

Attachment: Ortho_DPA_Redline_v2.pdf (redline comments)

-----Original Message Follows-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-30 14:22 -0700
Subject: FW: OrthoHealth — DPA redline and evidence needs

Sofia — forwarding Emily's redlines. Quick read-through:
- We can accept the SCCs + UK Addendum conditionally; Laura's note: we need to document the lawful basis and operational routing guarantees.
- The redline requests broader audit rights and longer retention for logs — push back on scope, propose a timeboxed SOC2 + artifact delivery rather than open-ended audits.

Action items for me: I will prepare a 1-page position memo for procurement and draft our response to the DPA redline (call out any non-starters).

Vivek: can you lead on the TIA/DTIA short risk note? Specifically: backups, DR replication locations, and whether any managed DB or caching layers persist full plaintext customer content.

Priyom: please generate the subprocessor inventory CSV and flag any subs that process EU/UK data on non-EU infrastructure. Aim to include contact, host region, encryption at rest status, and whether we have contractual subprocessor commitments.

I'll slot a quick review meeting on Oct 31 if that works for everyone.

- Laura

-----Original Message-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01 08:46 -0800
Subject: RE: OrthoHealth — DPA redline and evidence needs

Team,

I've pulled the initial risk notes together. Key points:
- Backups/DR: Our primary cloud provider replicates snapshots into a US region for DR; backups are encrypted at rest with customer keys managed by Redwood KMS. We cannot guarantee EU-only geographic residency for DR snapshots without a new infra change (costly, timeboxed).
- TIA approach: For high-sensitivity customers like OrthoHealth, recommend a TIA/DTIA letter describing compensating controls (encryption in transit and at rest, strict access controls, limited personnel access, and monitoring/alerting). That plus SCCs + UK Addendum should be acceptable for most procurement teams.
- Subprocessors: I flagged two managed analytics partners that have processing nodes in the US. We can offer to scope those out of the initial integration or provide contractual commitments that they will not access decrypted customer content.

I'll add more detail to the Drive note and link it in my follow-up. If Legal agrees, we can provide a short TIA template and the subprocessor CSV to OrthoHealth by Nov 2.

-Vivek
Senior InfoSec Engineer
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01 11:17 -0800
Subject: RE: OrthoHealth — DPA redline and evidence needs

Attached is the subprocessor_inventory_20261029.csv (stubbed). Columns: subprocessor_name, service, host_region, processes_plaintext, contractual_commitment_link. I highlighted two entries that include US processing: ManagedMetrics Inc and Cachelette LLC.

Notes:
- ManagedMetrics: analytics + ephemeral logs; does not persist long-term customer content but does receive telemetry that may include identifiers. Contractual commitment in place to prohibit access to decrypted data.
- Cachelette: managed caching layer; we can configure EU-only zones but would require a migration window and minor infra downtime for some customers.

Let me know if you want me to remove a subprocessor from the OrthoHealth onboarding plan temporarily while we negotiate.

-Priyom
Product Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment: subprocessors_inventory_20261029.csv

-----Original Message-----
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chau <emily.chau@orthohealth.com>, Michael Smith <michael.smith@lawfirmllp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02 15:03 -0700
Subject: RE: OrthoHealth — DPA redline and evidence needs

Hi Emily / Michael,

Thanks for the redline and the clear asks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Short summary and proposed path forward below.

1) Contractual safeguards
- We can accept the EU SCCs and the UK Addendum conditionally. Laura will send a short position memo and our clean DPA with marginal redlines by Nov 3.

2) Subprocessor inventory
- Attached: subprocessors_inventory_20261029.csv (see highlighted lines for the two partners with US processing). Priyom: the CSV includes regions and whether the subprocessor can access decrypted content.

3) Backups / DR & TIA approach
- Vivek: snapshot replication targets a US region for DR; snapshots are encrypted at rest with Redwood KMS. We will provide a TIA/DTIA letter describing compensating controls and monitoring; this will be delivered alongside the DPA.

4) Audit rights and log retention
- We will not agree to open-ended onsite audits. Instead we propose: a timeboxed evidence bundle (SOC 2 report, redacted audit artifacts) and an annual compliance attestation. Laura will capture the exact language in her response.

Deliverables and timeline:
- Nov 3: Laura to circulate DPA response + 1-page legal position memo
- Nov 3: Vivek to post TIA template + short DR backup note to Drive
- Nov 3: Sofia to upload consolidated evidence pack (Drive link) and share to OrthoHealth procurement

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBEx-Redwood-OrthoEvidence
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/OrthoHealth

If this plan looks good, can we schedule a 20-min alignment call on Nov 4 (your time) to walk through the evidence and confirm acceptance criteria?

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments: subprocessors_inventory_20261029.csv, SCCs-UK-Addendum-annotations.pdf, Ortho_DPA_Redline_v2.pdf
